name: Knowledge Base
description: Build a searchable knowledge base with articles, categories, and contributor management — powered by Commander Documents, Tables, and Search. Replaces Guru, Confluence, and Notion wikis.

sections.name: Article Editor
sections.purpose: Rich text editor for writing/editing articles with markdown support, auto-save, and category assignment

sections.name: Public Reader
sections.purpose: Clean public-facing reader view with category navigation, breadcrumbs, and 'Was this helpful?' voting

sections.name: Category Manager
sections.purpose: Manage categories with icons, colours, nesting, and sort order

sections.name: Search
sections.purpose: Full-text search across all published articles with filters and highlighting

sections.name: Dashboard
sections.purpose: Overview: total articles, views, helpful ratings, top articles, recent drafts

design.colorPalette: Clean — purple (#7C3AED) primary, white background, green for published, amber for draft

what_you_build: A searchable knowledge base with articles, categories, contributor management, and helpful ratings. Replaces Guru, Confluence, and Notion wikis.
starter_prompt: I want to build a knowledge base using the WaymakerOS Knowledge Base blueprint. Use host_blueprint_get with blueprint_id "knowledge-base" to get the full blueprint, then guide me through building it.
seo_title: Knowledge Base App Template — Build with AI | WaymakerOS
seo_description: Build a custom knowledge base with rich text articles, categories, search, and helpful ratings. Replaces Guru and Confluence — built on your data, in your workspace.
